int go(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long k = 1;
    int cnt = 1;
    while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    int res1 = go(n % k) + (int)(n / k) * cnt;
    int res2 = go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + (int)((k * 10 + 1 - n) / k) * cnt;
    return min(res1, res2);
}

class SegmentTree {
public:
    int maxn = 100010;
    vector<long long> st;
    SegmentTree() : st(4 * maxn, 0) {}
    void update(int node, int i, int L, int R, long long val) {
        if (i < L || i > R) return;
        if (L == R) {
            st[node] += val;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        update(node << 1, i, L, mid, val);
        update((node << 1) + 1, i, mid + 1, R, val);
        st[node] = st[node << 1] + st[(node << 1) + 1];
    }
    long long query(int node, int l, int r, int L, int R) {
        if (l > R || r < L) return 0;
        if (l <= L && r >= R) return st[node];
        int mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        return query(node << 1, l, r, L, mid) + query((node << 1) + 1, l, r, mid + 1, R);
    }
};

class Matrix {
public:
    static const int maxn = 2;
    int x[maxn][maxn] = {{0, 0}, {0, 0}};
    Matrix mul(const Matrix& A) const {
        Matrix res;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < maxn; k++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < maxn; j++) {
                    res.x[i][j] = (int)((res.x[i][j] + (long long)x[i][k] * A.x[k][j]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
    Matrix pow(long long k) const {
        Matrix res;
        // Initialize res as identity matrix
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            res.x[i][i] = 1;
        }
        Matrix T = *this;
        k--;
        while (k > 0) {
            if (k & 1) {
                res = res.mul(T);
            }
            T = T.mul(T);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

struct Pair {
    long long fi, se;
    Pair(long long fi_, long long se_) : fi(fi_), se(se_) {}
    bool operator<(const Pair& oth) const {
        if (fi > oth.fi) return false;
        if (fi < oth.fi) return true;
        if (se > oth.se) return false;
        if (se < oth.se) return true;
        return false;
    }
};

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long r = a % b;
        a = b;
        b = r;
    }
    return a;
}

long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

long long fpow(long long n, long long k, int p) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (k > 0) {
        if (k & 1) {
            r = r * n % p;
        }
        n = n * n % p;
        k >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

#include <gmpxx.h>

mpz_class FloorOfNthRoot(const mpz_class& x, int n) {
    if (n <= 0 || x < 0) {
        throw invalid_argument("Invalid input");
    }
    if (x == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return x;
    }
    mpz_class a, b, bigN, bigNMinusOne;
    bigN = n;
    bigNMinusOne = n - 1;
    size_t bits = mpz_sizeinbase(x.get_mpz_t(), 2);
    mpz_class base;
    base = mpz_class(1) << (bits / n + 1);
    b = base;
    do {
        a = b;
        mpz_class numerator = a * bigNMinusOne + x / mpz_pow_ui(a.get_mpz_t(), n - 1);
        mpz_class denominator = bigN;
        mpz_divexact(b.get_mpz_t(), numerator.get_mpz_t(), denominator.get_mpz_t());
    } while (b < a);
    return a;
}

cpp_dec_float_50 sqrt(const cpp_dec_float_50& A, int SCALE) {
    cpp_dec_float_50 x0 = 0;
    cpp_dec_float_50 x1 = sqrt(A.convert_to<double>());

        x1 += x0;
        x1 /= 2;

}
